rules.title: Prevent duplicate processing
rules.description: Define idempotency and de-duplication behavior for retried or repeated transaction requests.
rules.remediation_guidance: Specify the idempotency key, its scope and lifetime, and the result returned for a duplicate request.

rules.title: Protect sensitive data
rules.description: Define appropriate protection for sensitive data in logs, transit, and storage.
rules.remediation_guidance: Identify sensitive fields and state the required masking and encryption behavior for each processing context.

rules.title: Maintain an immutable activity trail
rules.description: Capture who performed a material action, what changed, and when it occurred.
rules.remediation_guidance: State the events that must be audited and the actor, timestamp, outcome, and change details retained for each event.

rules.title: Preserve consistent transaction state
rules.description: Define atomicity, rollback, and recovery behavior when a multi-step operation fails.
rules.remediation_guidance: Identify the consistency boundary and specify rollback or compensating actions for every partial-failure point.

rules.title: Bound dependency failures
rules.description: Define timeout, retry, backoff, and circuit-breaking behavior for fallible dependencies.
rules.remediation_guidance: Specify bounded timeouts and retries, including the user-visible or operational outcome after retries are exhausted.

rules.title: Identify applicable obligations
rules.description: Identify and satisfy financial regulations explicitly applicable to the product and jurisdiction.
applicability_hints: a supplied policy names an obligation
rules.remediation_guidance: Confirm the jurisdiction and applicable obligation, then map it to a testable requirement and supporting evidence.

rules.title: Define material failure outcomes
rules.description: Describe behavior for relevant business and technical failure states.
applicability_hints: depends on external or stateful processing
rules.remediation_guidance: Add testable outcomes for each material business rejection, technical failure, timeout, and interrupted flow.

rules.title: Govern partner and API access
rules.description: Define relevant authentication, isolation, replay, versioning, quota, webhook, and partner-lifecycle controls.
rules.remediation_guidance: Specify the partner identity, tenant boundary, interface contract, usage limits, and onboarding and offboarding behavior.

rules.title: Control delegated corporate actions
rules.description: Define legal-entity scope, delegated users, entitlements, approvals, and bulk-processing behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Define who may create, review, approve, and release each action and how item and batch outcomes are represented.

rules.title: Cover the full financial lifecycle
rules.description: Define applicable authorization, posting, reversal, settlement, reconciliation, repair, fee, FX, limit, and date behavior.
rules.remediation_guidance: Document the applicable transaction states and the transition, ownership, and recovery behavior for each state.

rules.title: Define operational safeguards
rules.description: Address applicable data lifecycle, observability, recovery, capacity, rollout, and support responsibilities.
rules.remediation_guidance: State measurable operational expectations and assign ownership for monitoring, recovery, rollout, and support.

rules.title: Meet stage-appropriate requirement quality
rules.description: Provide the scope, outcomes, dependencies, risks, decisions, testability, and sign-off appropriate to the delivery stage.
applicability_hints: all projects, calibrated to delivery stage
rules.remediation_guidance: Add only the missing artifacts expected at the current delivery stage, with measurable outcomes and clear ownership.
